data.task_title: Create Artemis self-demo with Chart.js visualization

features.title: Live Metrics Dashboard
features.description: Implement a real-time dashboard with Chart.js graphs.
acceptance_criteria: Include a line chart for LLM cost over time
Include a bar chart for stage completion rates
Include an area chart for success rate trends

features.title: Results Presentation
features.description: Display real metrics from recent runs in the presentation.
acceptance_criteria: Include actual data from recent runs
Ensure data is presented clearly and accurately
Highlight key results and insights

features.title: Feature Metrics Visualization
features.description: Showcase cost tracking, sandboxing, and learning metrics using charts.
acceptance_criteria: Include charts for cost tracking, sandboxing, and learning metrics
Ensure data is accurate and up-to-date
Use different chart types to represent different metrics

features.title: Code Quality Visualization
features.description: Visualize TDD compliance and SOLID principles using a radar chart.
acceptance_criteria: Create a radar chart for TDD compliance and SOLID principles
Ensure data is accurate and reflective of current standards
Use interactive elements to allow users to explore data

features.title: HERO Slide: Introduction to Artemis
features.description: Create a HERO slide introducing Artemis as an Autonomous AI Development System.
acceptance_criteria: Include a clear and concise description of Artemis
Ensure the slide is visually engaging
Highlight key capabilities of Artemis

features.title: Pipeline Visualization
acceptance_criteria: Create a chart representing the 8-stage pipeline
Ensure each stage is clearly labeled and distinct
Use animations to enhance understanding of the pipeline flow

features.title: HTML Presentation Template
features.description: Create a standalone HTML file using existing demos as templates.
acceptance_criteria: Use contract_analytics_dashboard.html, lead_opportunity_intelligence_demo.html, and artemis_complete_demo.html as templates
Embed CSS, JavaScript, and Chart.js within the HTML file
Ensure the HTML file is standalone and does not require external resources

features.title: Chart.js Integration
features.description: Integrate Chart.js for data visualization within the presentation.
acceptance_criteria: Include Chart.js library in the HTML file
Use Chart.js to create visualizations for pipeline metrics, cost tracking, and success rates
Ensure charts are responsive and visually appealing

features.title: Auto-Advance and Navigation Controls
features.description: Implement auto-advance functionality with navigation controls for the presentation.
acceptance_criteria: Slides auto-advance after a set duration
Include navigation controls for manual slide progression
Ensure controls are intuitive and responsive

features.title: Supervisor Integration Visualization
features.description: Show supervisor integration across stages using a pie chart.
acceptance_criteria: Create a pie chart representing supervisor integration
Ensure each segment is clearly labeled
Use animations to enhance user engagement

features.title: Professional Design
features.description: Design the presentation with a professional gradient background and smooth transitions.
acceptance_criteria: Implement a gradient background across all slides
Ensure transitions between slides are smooth and professional
Maintain a consistent design theme throughout the presentation
